contract.voice: official public M1 style (semantic SID5; standalone JSON serialized at index 0)
contract.fixed_shape_limitation: The deployment graph remains predeclared T239/L238/729746 rather than being rebuilt from the duration prediction.

routes.cpu: all four official FP32 components on CPUExecutionProvider; original specialized official FP32 vector
routes.all_htp: shape-specialized duration/text/vocoder plus stable-Softplus vector, every neural session on QNNExecutionProvider with CPU fallback disabled; preprocessing, orchestration, trimming, and WAV encoding on CPU

benchmark.thermal_capture: adb dumpsys thermalservice immediately before and after each route; non-invasive and observational only
benchmark.setup_inclusive_to_first_definition: sum of all four session-creation times plus first complete generation latency
benchmark.complete_process_definition: wall time around the fresh route process, recorded by the phone shell
benchmark.rtf_definition: complete generation latency divided by 16.5475283446712 seconds of output audio
benchmark.memory: getrusage ru_maxrss cumulative process high-water; includes runtime, models, provider, and allocator and is not component-isolated PSS

precision_claim_boundary: The source models are official FP32 ONNX inference/export assets. Actual QNN HTP internal float lowering precision is not established; no FP32-arithmetic claim is permitted.
